The machine is **M64-32ms**, a virtual machine with dual Xeon E7-8890v3 processors (32 vCPUs) and **1792 GB of DDR3 RAM**. The paper says it is used "to build a one-shot in-memory index for billion point datasets" (page 8).

Building the one-shot index on this machine took about 2 days, and peak memory use was about 1100 GB (page 8).
